request.auth: Basic user ID/password, no default chain
request.mapping: typed request fields; absent optional fields omitted; values retained explicitly
request.period: explicit Start/End; logs after millisecond conversion; range step exact decimal seconds

response.numeric_precision: integer/decimal literals and sample strings retained without float64
response.completeness: bounded partial collection/prefix, never a successful full result on limit
response.provider_metadata: resultType, typed scalar/string/series/histograms plus original sample timestamps
response.string_result: StringSample.Timestamp exact decimal, Value ProtectedValue explicit Reveal; null string rejected as ProtocolError. Numeric samples remain exact strings.
response.bounded_prefix: response_limit and Complete=false retain decoded prefix and warnings/infos, namespace/evaluation/range metadata; no provider-wide completeness claim.

errors.sample_limit: response_limit, typed bounded prefix, complete false

retry: bounded safe reads; each retry receives new signature when applicable

source_reconciliation.status: partial retained; additional upstream methods/options/formats and Selectel remote_write ingestion remain unconfirmed
source_reconciliation.search_limit: Current Selectel tool/get/directory pages plus targeted primary-domain search for query_range, timeout API and namespace POST; no inference from search absence or one error response.
